# dsh-agent-manager

Stop **and really remove** subagents and Agent Teams teammates in DeepSeek Harness.
| 子代理 / 团队成员的管理插
件：停止运行实例，并从「子代理目录」和「团队花名册」里真正移除。

The host ships no delete on either domain — `ctx.subagents` can interrupt a child
and release it, `c

tx.agentTeams` keeps a *flat immutable roster* — so both lists
grow forever. This plugin adds the mi

ssing half: a model tool layer, a header
panel in the web GUI, and an offline CLI.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.1 < 0.3.0-0` (the session-log layout and the
`agentTeams` / `subagen

ts` services this plugin drives are from that line).
- A profile that mounts the team/subagent bundl

es — the stock `desktop` and
`web` profiles do; headless profiles without `agentTeams` simply get no

teammate rows.
- Node `^22.15 || >=24` (the offline CLI uses `node:zlib` zstd support).

Paths in this document are examples from a Windows install; nothing in the
plugin is path-specific (
it resolves `DSH_HOME`, then `~/.dsh`).
## Where it lives
| what | path |

| source | `C:\Users\lin\.dsh\plugins\src\dsh-agent-manager` |
| package (installed from) | `C:\User

s\lin\.dsh\plugins\packs\dsh-agent-manager-<version>.tgz` |
| installed copy | `C:\Users\lin\.dsh\pr

ofiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-agent-manager` |
| backups / trash | `C:\Users\lin\.dsh\agent-manage
r\{backups,trash}\<timestamp>\` |

The profile dependency is a packed tarball (`file:…tgz`), not a `link:`: the
installed copy is a rea

l directory, so the source tree can be moved or deleted
without breaking the app.
## UI (web GUI)

Conversation header → **代理管理** (a count badge shows «teammates · subagents»).
Click it: a panel list

s every teammate (name, phase, running state) and every
subagent (label, parent, depth, running stat
e), each with two actions:

- **停止** — interrupt the running turn and release the resident instance
(frees an `maxActiveSubagent

s` slot). Nothing is deleted.
- **移除** — two clicks. The row first asks **确认移除**, and then offers tw

o
disposals: **进回收站** (stop, retire the catalog/roster record in the parent
session log, move the ch

ild's session directory to the plugin trash — the file
can be moved back) or **彻底删除** (the same, but

the directory is deleted
outright — no trash copy, no undo).

The panel footer shows the trash (`N 项 · size`) with a two-click **清空回收站**,
and the footer line repo
rts where the trash and the log backups live.

The panel title carries a small `vX.Y.Z` badge read from the **running** copy of
the plugin (`/agent

-manager/api/list` → `result.version`). After installing a new
build, this badge is the quickest way

to tell whether the app really reloaded it:
an old badge means the host is still running the previo

us module, so quit the app
from the tray and start it again (closing the window only hides it).
Closing the panel: click the backdrop, press Esc, or click the header button again.
## Tools (host plugin layer)
| tool | what it does |
| `agent_list` | List this conversation's subagents and teammates with session ids and running state

. |
| `agent_stop` | Cancel the running turn and release the resident instance. Nothing is deleted.

|
| `agent_remove` | Stop → retire the catalog/roster records in this session's own log → move the c
hild's session directory to the plugin's trash. `purge: true` deletes the directory instead of trash
ing it (no undo); `keep_files: true` leaves the files; `dry_run: true` only reports. |
Typical use in a conversation:

> 把 dft-runner 这个团队成员删掉 → `agent_remove(target: "dft-runner")`
> 只停掉那个还在跑的 subagent → `agent_stop(ta
rget: "<session id>")`

`target` accepts a teammate name (`dft-runner`), a subagent label when unique, or a
session id.
## Why rewriting a log is safe here

A session log is an append-only, zstd-framed JSONL file whose events carry a
contiguous `seq`, and `

compaction/summary` records refer back to `seq` ranges.
Deleting a line would leave a hole; renumber
ing would slide every reference.

So nothing is deleted: the record is **retired in place** — same `seq`, same
`time`, rewritten as an
unknown event type carrying `ignorable: true`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The v4 loader keeps unknown *ignorable* records verbatim, and every projection
only folds its own ev

ent type, so the catalog row and the roster entry disappear
while the event count and the `seq` set

stay identical. The self-test asserts
exactly that (`npm run selftest`).

Two more guards: the original file is copied to
`$DSH_HOME/agent-manager/backups/<timestamp>/` befor

e the rewrite, the write is
aborted if the file's size/mtime changes between read and rename (the ho

st
appends per batch, so this only trips while the session is actually writing),
and the child's dir

ectory goes to `$DSH_HOME/agent-manager/trash/<timestamp>/`
rather than being deleted — unless you p
ick **彻底删除** / `purge: true`, which skips the trash on purpose.
## Offline CLI

The tools and the panel write through a live host. When the session you want to
clean is the one bei

ng written right now, quit DSH (tray → Exit) and use the CLI
from the installed copy:

Source of truth is the src directory; after editing it, rebuild and redeploy in
one step (appends a

new tarball, swaps the profile dependency, keeps the bundle
entry):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then restart the desktop app — **tray → Exit**, then launch. Closing the window
only hides it, and a
running host keeps the old module loaded.
Manual equivalent:

## Limits

- `--purge` / `purge: true` is destructive: the conversation itself is gone;
the parent log backup u
nder `agent-manager/backups/` is the only trace left.

- Retiring the roster does **not** rewrite `team/task` history: tasks that named
the removed member

keep its id in the log (they render as unknown assignees).
- The child's conversation itself is unto

uched — it is moved, not shredded; put
